query_text: Build a music lyric fill-in-the-blank game app for phone where a song lyric pops up with one or two words blanked out and you have to type in what you think goes there, then it tells you right away if you got it right and keeps a running score so you can see how well you know the songs you love.

Create a literature character identification quiz app for my phone where it gives you a short description or a famous quote and you have to pick which book character said it or matches the clue, with a few choices to tap on each round, and at the end it shows you your score plus a little note about each character you got right or wrong.

Create a mythology and legend character quiz app that I can play on my phone when I want to test how much I remember about gods, heroes, and creatures from different cultures, where each round shows you a clue or a description and you pick the right name from a few options, and it tracks how many you get right in a row so there is a streak counter.

A diet-friendly snack randomizer app for mobile where you tap a big spin button and it picks a healthy low-calorie snack option for you, pulling from a built-in list of things like fruit, nuts, yogurt, and veggie sticks, and each result shows the snack name plus a rough calorie count so you feel good about what you just picked.

Make a debate topic randomizer app for mobile that spins up a fresh debate prompt every time you tap the button, so my friends and I always have something interesting to argue about during lunch or a hangout, and the app should split each topic into two clear sides so everyone knows which position they are defending.

Build a random compliment generator wheel app for my phone where you spin a colorful wheel and it lands on a warm, uplifting compliment to send to a friend or just read yourself when you need a little boost, and you can tap a copy button to grab the text and paste it anywhere you like.

Make a fun ice cream flavour randomizer app for my phone where you hit a big scoop button and it picks a random flavour for you from a long list including classics and weird combos, so the next time I am standing at the counter and cannot decide what to get I can just let the app choose for me and it shows a little picture or color to go with the flavour.

A weekend activity adventure randomizer app for my phone where you give it a quick tap and it throws out a fun thing to do this weekend, pulling from different categories like outdoor, creative, social, and chill, so my friends and I can stop going back and forth and just go with whatever the app says, with a short description of the activity so we know what we are getting into.

Build a random artist or musician discovery app for mobile that surfaces one interesting artist each time you tap, pulling from a wide mix of styles and eras so you always stumble on someone new, and each card shows the artist name, a one-sentence description of their style, and a genre tag so you can decide in seconds whether you want to explore more.

Need a Tower of Hanoi puzzle app for my phone that lets me pick how many discs I want to work with, then shows the three pegs and the stacked discs so I can tap and move them one at a time until I get the whole stack onto the target peg, and it counts my moves so I can try to beat my own record next time.

Create a game app for my phone that has both tic-tac-toe and four-in-a-row so my friend and I can switch between them whenever we want, where we both play on the same phone taking turns tapping, and the app highlights the winning row when someone wins and tracks wins for each player in a running total at the top.

Create an Othello flip-disc strategy game app playable on my phone where you tap an empty spot on the board to place your piece and all the opponent discs in between automatically flip to your color, and there is a simple computer opponent you can play against when no one else is around, with a score counter showing how many discs each side owns.

Need a dots and boxes game app for mobile where two players take turns drawing lines between dots on a grid, and whenever someone completes a box they claim it and get a point, with the board showing filled boxes in different colors for each player and a score tally at the top updating in real time as the game goes on.

Make a word search game app for my phone with a grid of hidden letters where you drag your finger across the screen to highlight words from a list, and when you find one it crosses off the word from the list and stays highlighted on the grid in a bright color, with a timer so you can challenge yourself to finish before time runs out.

A pipe connect flow puzzle app for my phone where each level gives you a grid of pipe pieces and you rotate them by tapping until all the connections line up and water can flow from one end to the other without any leaks, with levels getting gradually trickier as you go and a little animation when you solve the puzzle correctly.

A cozy cat petting simulator app for my phone with warm pastel tones and a soft fluffy cat sitting right in the middle of the screen, where you stroke the cat with your finger and it reacts with gentle purring sounds and little heart animations that float up, and the longer you pet the more relaxed the cat looks, making the whole thing feel like a tiny calming ritual.

A meteor shower meditative experience app for my phone where the screen is a deep blue-black night sky and streaks of light drift slowly across it in waves, each one trailing a soft glow that fades gently, so it feels like lying on a hillside watching the sky in complete silence, and you can tap anywhere to send a little ripple of stars outward as if you are touching the sky.

Create a lava lamp animation toy app for my phone that fills the whole screen with slow-moving blobs in warm, dreamy colors like deep amber and coral that rise and melt together the way a real lava lamp does, with a soft glow behind each blob and a gentle pulsing rhythm to the movement so it feels genuinely hypnotic and calming to stare at.

Create a bouncy ball physics toy app for my phone where colorful balls roll and bounce around the screen in a really satisfying way, and you can tilt your phone to shift the gravity direction so they all slide toward whatever side you tip toward, with a setting to add more balls or change how bouncy they are so you can play around with the feel of it.

A colour mixing paint toy app for my phone where the whole screen is your canvas and you finger-paint with rich swirling colours that blend and flow into each other the way real wet paint does, the colours staying vivid and smooth with a gorgeous marbled effect when two shades meet, and a reset button that melts everything back to a clean slate with a satisfying swirl animation.

Need a Newton cradle simulator app for my phone that looks gorgeous and feels deeply satisfying to interact with, where you can pull back one or more of the gleaming metal balls and let them swing into the others, hearing that crisp clacking sound and watching the motion ripple back and forth in perfect rhythm, and you can adjust how many balls you release at once.

Build a photo editing tool for my phone focused on HDR and shadow recovery, where you load any photo and the app brings out the detail that got lost in the dark areas and brightens the dull spots, making everything feel richer and more alive without washing out the highlights, with a before-and-after split view so you can really see the difference the edit is making.

Create a meme maker app for my phone where you pick a photo from your gallery or use one of the built-in classic meme templates, then type your top and bottom caption text in a big bold font that sits perfectly on the image, and you can tweak the text size and color before saving or sharing, so the whole thing is quick and feels effortless.

Make a photo cleanup tool for my phone that smooths out the graininess in dark or low-light shots and brings the edges back into crisp focus, with two sliders you can drag to control how much noise reduction and how much sharpening you want, plus a side-by-side view showing the original and the cleaned-up version so you can find the sweet spot that looks most natural.

Create a panorama photo tool for my phone where you can load two or more overlapping shots and the app stitches them together into one wide seamless image, and there is a horizon straightening feature so if the shot came out slightly tilted you can level it out with a simple drag, then crop and save the final wide-angle result that actually looks polished.
